2.8.1.title: Screen tab: screenshot sirf jab tum maango + sab commands wahin
bullets: Koi auto loop nahi — screenshot sirf Refresh pe, tab khulne pe, ya kisi action ke baad (1s/5s/10s wala polling hata diya)
Screen tab me naya Commands console — /help, /brief, /usage, /watch, /use, /undo sab wahin chalte hain
Tap pe extra screenshot nahi — frame ka size yaad rehta hai (Wayland portal prompt kam)
Screen nahi badla to 304 — wahi image dobara download nahi hoti

2.8.0.title: undo, watch, usage, teach, brief, resume + phone se remote control
bullets: Phone app me naya *Screen* tab — live screen + tap-to-click + typing, same Wi-Fi ya Tailscale se kahin se bhi
/undo — pichhla file kaam wapas (write/move/copy/delete/mkdir/zip), /undo list se journal
/watch <condition> — screen pe nazar: 'jab ye ho jaye to batao' (screenshot + vision, cooldown ke saath)
/usage — aaj ka AI quota model-wise, 80% pe warning (Groq/OpenRouter/Gemini/local)
/teach start <naam> → commands karo → /teach stop → phir /<naam> se poora sequence
/brief — reminders + todos + jobs + disk/battery ek message me; /brief on 9am roz · /resume se adhoora kaam
Live progress 'step 2/8' long tasks me · photo bhejo + 'fix karo' to vision diagnosis
observer.sh autoupdate on — roz raat update, subah WhatsApp pe report

2.7.0.title: stop button, screen vision, update messages
bullets: /stop — chalta hua kaam turant rukta hai (stacked kaam bhi), partial steps batata hai
Screen ab OCR nahi — screenshot seedha vision model (Gemini/Groq/local) ko jaata hai
Har step tez: OCR hata, 1024px JPEG q70, 550ms settle — chhota upload, kam tokens
Update hone pe WhatsApp message: kya naya + kitna time laga

2.6.0.title: hands — real computer use
bullets: /use: screenshot → ek action → dobara screenshot (insaan ki tarah)
computer_use tool — AI khud screen pe click/type kar sakta hai
Stuck detection, 8-step budget, cloud-screen privacy toggle

2.5.4.title: page load false failure fix
bullets: Page khulne ke baad bhi 'page load nahi hua' aana band
Chat sites pe seedha type + Enter (click nahi)
Prompt se domain naam nahi kata jaata

2.5.3.title: security review
bullets: ~/.ssh aur ~/.gnupg me write band (read-only block ab write pe bhi)
TTS me shell injection fix (text2wave bina shell)
Bridge token ka comparison constant-time
